title: Pet Tag vs. Pet GPS: Which Does Your Pet Need?
summary: Enjoy and learn from Life360's blog archive, focused on user life stories and experiences with our premier family safety app.
body_markdown:
Real talk: shopping for pet safety gear is confusing. GPS tracker or smart ID tag? Which one’s better? You go down the rabbit hole, compare specs, and somehow end up more lost than your hypothetically missing dog.


Here’s the thing nobody tells you: they’re not competing. They cover two completely different moments — the moment your pet bolts, and the moment a stranger finds them three streets over. Luckily, we've got the dream duo of pet finding perfect for both occasions. Wherever your pet wanders, and whoever finds them, we've got the gear that gets them home.


One more thing before you choose: neither of these is a clip it on and forget it exists situation. Both plug into the same Life360 app your family already uses — the one with care logs and reminders for every pet. And for Life360 Pet GPS households, daily Zoomies alerts and a Weekly Roundup of their adventures too. So whichever you pick, you’re not just buying a device. You’re getting the whole pet experience that comes with it.


***More than a tracker, more than a tag: one place for everything your pet needs.***


## **The 30-second answer (no, really)**


**Start free** if you just want your pet covered before you buy anything. A free Pet Profile puts them on the Pet Finder Network, one of the largest community-powered lost pet networks in the world, and unlocks care logs and reminders for the whole household — no device, no subscription. Add a Life360 Pet Tag or Pet GPS whenever you’re ready to level up their protection.


**Get Life360 Pet GPS** if your pet roams, bolts, or is an off-leash opportunist. A simple solution to get real-time location, plus an ASAP alert when they frolic too far or cross a line they shouldn't have. ($99 for year one — covers the device plus a Silver membership — renews annually after that*)


**Get Life360 Pet Tag** your lost pet spiral scenario is a stranger finding your escape artist with zero way to reach you. Think of it as your low-tech lifeline. ($7.99, one time. No subscription. No battery. Ever.)


Get both if you want the dream team of pet protection — Pet GPS for the finding, Pet Tag for the reunion.


## **Two products, two totally different problems**


Picture the two ways you'd need to find a missing pet. There are really only two storylines.


Story one: you lose track of them. The gate got left open. The leash slipped. They heard a firework and made a break for it. You don’t know where they are, and every second counts.


That’s the active-finding problem — and it’s exactly what Pet GPS is built for. Real-time location on a cellular network on the same Life360 map your family already uses, plus an Escape Alert the moment your pet crosses a boundary you’ve set.


Story two: someone else finds them first. Your pet is safe, collecting head pats from a stranger who has no way to reach you. That's the recovery problem, and the Pet Tag ends that storyline in one scan. A stainless-steel QR code tag that anyone can scan with their phone (no app required), which quickly pings your whole Circle without ever exposing your number.


Pet GPS answers “where is my pet right now?” Pet Tag answers “how does the person holding my pet reach me?” Different questions. Same goal: get them home.


Both, though, plug into the same app. Every pet you add with a Life360 Pet Tag, Life360 Pet GPS, or just a free profile — gets care logs and shared reminders, so feedings, walks, meds, and more live in one place the whole household can see, instead of scattered across 4 different apps or just someone's memory. Add Pet GPS and you also unlock the daily connection features: a Zoomies alert the moment your pet has a burst of joy, and a Weekly Roundup showing who completed the most care tasks, and how far they roamed. It's not just about powerful tail-tracking. It's everything you need for four paws, now in one spot.


## **What’s your pet’s escape style? (be honest.)**


The fastest way to choose is to get real about how your specific mischief maker is most likely to go missing. Find your scenario:


### **The homebody dog**


Your risk isn’t a cross-country adventure — it’s the rare, dramatic slip through a door left ajar, ending with a neighbor who finds a friendly pet and absolutely no way to reach you. Start with Pet Tag. It's $7.99, no subscription needed, no app required for the finder, and has no battery — so there is absolutely no maintenance. Clip it on today, it works today. If they're not really the roaming type, a tag might be all you need.


### **The backyard Houdini**


Over the fence. Under the gate. Gone before you noticed the back door was open. This is Pet GPS territory. The Escape Alert fires the moment they cross your geofence, so you're already moving while they're still on the next block. Pair it with Life360 Pet Tag for a one-scan way for whoever finds them first to reach you.


### **The off-leash adventurer**


Hiking trails, open fields, need a cellular signal to work. Life360 Pet GPS is non-negotiable — it uses GPS, cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth to stay connected, and even if the battery dies, Reserve Mode keeps your pet findable via the 100-million-phone Life360 network for up to six months. Pair it with Pet Tag for the human-to-human handoff when someone meets your dog at the trailhead.


### **The budget-conscious pet parent**


Start with a free Pet Profile — it’s the real $0 option, and it already gets your pet onto the Pet Finder Network with care logs and reminders for the whole household. Ready for something more tangible? Add Pet Tag at $7.99 one-time with no subscription, the lowest-cost way to give your pet a real path home. Plenty of owners start here and add Pet GPS when they’re ready for real-time tracking. There’s no wrong order.

## **Common questions**


### **Should I get a GPS tracker or an ID tag for my dog?**


If your dog roams, bolts, or goes off-leash, lead with Pet GPS — you need real-time location and escape alerts. If your main worry is a stranger finding your dog with no way to reach you, Pet Tag handles that for $7.99, no subscription. Dogs who do both? Get both.


### **Do I need to buy something to get started?**


No. Create a free Pet Profile with your pet’s photo and details in about 60 seconds, and they’re already covered by the Pet Finder Network, with care logs and reminders available to the whole household. Add a $7.99 Pet Tag or Pet GPS (starting at $99 for year one) whenever your pet's escape risk calls for it.


### **What is Life360 for Pets?**


It's the name for the whole pet experience inside the Life360 app: your pet on the family map, the Pet Finder Network, care logs and reminders, and — with Pet GPS — Zoomies alerts and a Weekly Roundup. Pet Tag and Pet GPS are the two ways in, and a free Pet Profile is where every family starts.


## **So, which one's for you?**


Listen, only you know whether your pet is a homebody or a certified flight risk. But we know the right way to pick: by escape risk, not the spec sheet. Wanderers get GPS. What if someone finds them and can't reach us? gets the Tag. And if you want the whole safety net — the real-time find and the one-scan reunion — run both.


Not ready to buy anything yet? Start with a free Pet Profile — every family gets covered by the Pet Finder Network at zero cost, and can add a Tag or GPS the moment they’re ready.


Every lost pet deserves a way home. Life360 covers both ways there.
